text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Epogen overdosage can cause hemoglobin levels above the desired level, which should be managed with discontinuation or reduction of Epogen dosage and/or with phlebotomy, as clinically indicated [see Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.2 )] . Cases of severe hypertension have been observed following overdose with ESAs [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.3 )] .
